steps.caption: The deployed one-screen shelf opens empty, with create, title list, and reader panels visible without a login.
Two cloud-backed snippets are listed, and the selected Sign-off shows its own Kind regards. body.
Selecting Greeting switches the same-screen reader to Hello, team! while both titles remain listed.
After a page reload, both titles return from cloud storage and Sign-off still opens with Kind regards.
After deleting Sign-off, Greeting remains listed and readable with Hello, team!.
A fresh browser context rebuilds the unchanged shelf from cloud data: Greeting is readable and deleted Sign-off is absent.
Submitting text without a title shows a clear title-required error and leaves the saved shelf unchanged.
Submitting whitespace-only text shows a clear text-required error and adds no snippet.
Markup-looking content is displayed literally as Hello in the plain-text reader.
